reason: The café sent it so I'd connect Instagram and try the free first collab, but I'm not paying ₹499 to a small beta team when I still don't know who I complain to if a business doesn't pay. Most of my collabs are barter anyway, so a yearly pass doesn't pay for itself yet.
objection: It's a beta with a small team and no real name or contact for disputes. If a business ghosts me, who helps? And as a pass holder I also have to make promo videos for participating businesses, which sounds like extra free work on top of what I already give in barter.
would_change_my_mind: If my free first collab actually turns into a paid one through Mitra, and they show a real company name, a support contact and how they handle a business that doesn't pay.
